info.title: API.SH: Sympla
info.description: The Sympla API from API.SH: public Sympla data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One Sympla event by id or link: name, start and end, type, category, theme, sub-theme, format, audience, tags, full description (text and HTML), venue with coordinates, online or course details, organizer (id, name, page, logo, and the legal entity name and CNPJ when the organizer is a company), every ticket type (price, discounted price, net price, service fee, free flag, sale window and status, per-order limits, tickets left, last-tickets and selling-fast flags, installment plans), ticket groups, service fee percent, installment rules, payment methods, refund and cancellation policies, page views and images. Events sold through Sympla's box-office system (bileto.sympla.com.br links) return the listing details with the price range and availability only.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/sympla-event

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: An event id (the number at the end of the link) or a sympla.com.br/evento/... or bileto.sympla.com.br/event/... link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search Sympla events (Brazil's largest ticketing site) with the site's own filters: text, city, state, theme, sub-theme, format, in person / online / on demand, free only, date range or date shortcut, audience and collection, ordered by relevance, start date, or the site's trending and popularity scores. Each event: id, name, link, start and end, theme, sub-theme, format, audience, tags, venue (name, address, neighborhood, city, state, ZIP, coordinates), organizer (id, name, page, logo, public email when listed), free flag, lowest and highest ticket price in BRL, tickets left, on sale and sold-out flags, active coupons, page views, image. Relevance and date orders also return facet counts (cities, states, themes, sub-themes, formats, types, audiences, collections) for building filters. Trending and popular orders take text, city (with state), state, type and dates only. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/sympla-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text (event, artist, venue or organizer name).

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City: the slug the site uses (sao-paulo-sp, rio-de-janeiro-rj, from /sympla/v1/cities) or a name with `state`.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Two-letter Brazilian state (UF), e.g. SP, RJ, MG.

parameters.name: theme
parameters.description: Theme as the site names it, e.g. MÚSICA E BALADA, TEATRO, EDUCAÇÃO E APRENDIZADO, ESPORTE E SAÚDE, GASTRONOMIA, PASSEIOS E TOURS (see `facets.theme`); comma-separate for any of several.

parameters.name: subtheme
parameters.description: Sub-theme, e.g. ROCK, PAGODE / SAMBA, STAND-UP COMEDY, MPB (see `facets.subtheme`).

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Format, e.g. SHOW, FESTIVAL, TEATRO, CURSO, PALESTRA, WORKSHOP (see `facets.format`).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: in_person, online or on_demand.

parameters.name: free
parameters.description: true for free events only, false for paid only.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: Date shortcut (Brasília time): today, tomorrow, this_week, this_weekend, next_week, this_month.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Events running on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Events starting on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: audience
parameters.description: Audience, e.g. ADULTOS, FAMÍLIA / INFANTIL, PROFISSIONAIS / CORPORATIVO (see `facets.audience`).

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: A collection key from `facets.collection`, e.g. festas_e_shows, eventos_em_alta.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), date, trending_day, trending_week, trending_month or popular.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page (default 24, max 50).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (from 1).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
